title: Local reconstruction
statement: A secret-sharing scheme has local reconstruction if, for every finite set of parties and any two assignments of shares that agree at every party in that set, reconstruction from the set gives the same result for both assignments.
hypotheses_covered: For every finite set $A$ and share assignments $f,g$, agreement at each party in $A$ implies equal reconstructions from $A$
